name: catalyst_tps_active_site_xattn_v1
purpose: Replace the failed global TPS dual-tower family with a two-stage, token-level active-site/reaction interaction reranker inspired by modern cross-attention enzyme-specificity models while preserving full TPS candidate coverage.
research_basis: EZSpecificity: cross-attention between enzyme structural context and substrate graph for fine-grained specificity (Nature 2025)
EnzymeHunter: sequence+structure hierarchical contrastive learning with attention concentrated on mechanistically critical sites (Cell Reports Methods 2026)
prohibited_selection_evidence: historical canonical 83-query development scores after CATALYST_TPS_FOUNDATION_R2E_V1

fresh_internal_split.assignment: blake2b(salt + '::' + protein_cluster, digest_size=8) interpreted big-endian modulo 5
fresh_internal_split.semantics: protein-cluster-cold discovery: training excludes every pair whose protein cluster belongs to the held-out fold; query reactions may be train-seen
fresh_internal_split.evaluation_mask: for each query mask all training-known positive proteins for that reaction before ranking; score only held-out protein-cluster positives

protein_tokens.motif_center_rule: reuse deterministic select_motif_contexts semantics; DDxxD/NSE-DTE/DxDD at most one selected center, QW at most two centers in sequence order
protein_tokens.missing_motif_behavior: masked padding; global token remains available

reaction_tokens.source: exact TPS reaction SMILES plus existing RXNMapper mapped reactions
reaction_tokens.changed_center_definition: same bond-order/presence plus atom-state change semantics as build_reaction_center_augmented_features.py

two_stage_retrieval.shortlist_generator: training-only association transfer using frozen global ESM-C and EnzGFM cosine similarities multiplied by binary-DRFP reaction Tanimoto
two_stage_retrieval.fallback_outside_shortlist: retain deterministic transfer ranking; reranker only permutes shortlist
two_stage_retrieval.transfer_score_per_representation: For query q and candidate p, max over training association pairs (p_i,r_i) of max(cosine(protein_repr(p), protein_repr(p_i)),0) * binary_2048_DRFPTanimoto(q,r_i). Only training pairs enter the max.
two_stage_retrieval.baseline_fusion: equal arithmetic mean of the ESM-C and EnzGFM transfer scores; deterministic tie break by candidate protein_id ascending
two_stage_retrieval.shortlist_order: union of each representation top160, then ordered by baseline equal-mean transfer score with candidate_id tie break; held-out labels never alter membership or order
two_stage_retrieval.final_order: reranked union shortlist is the complete leading prefix; append every non-shortlist candidate in deterministic equal-mean transfer order. Training-known positives for the query are masked before both prefix and tail construction.
two_stage_retrieval.baseline_comparator_order: identical union shortlist and identical tail; shortlist prefix is ordered by equal-mean transfer score only, so cross-attention and baseline have exactly the same candidate support.

interaction_model.family: bidirectional protein-token <-> reaction-atom cross-attention residual reranker
interaction_model.training_loss: PU-aware pairwise softplus ranking on known positives versus train-protein hard negatives, with stronger negatives drawn from sequence-near TPS proteins associated to different product skeletons
interaction_model.no_3d_requirement: 3D pocket features may be reported as future ablation but cannot gate candidate coverage in V1
interaction_model.hard_negative_pool_semantics: hard_negatives_per_positive is the fixed pool size, constructed from training proteins only and training association labels only; each epoch deterministically cycles one negative from that pool per positive rather than scoring all K simultaneously
interaction_model.hard_negative_pool_order: descending same-support baseline transfer score, preferring train proteins whose train-known product skeletons differ from the positive reaction; fill remaining slots by baseline order excluding every train-known positive for the reaction
interaction_model.epoch_negative_schedule: pool[(epoch_index + stable_blake2b(positive_pair)) mod pool_size]; this schedule is fixed and never reacts to development metrics
interaction_model.residual_combination: within each query shortlist, z=(baseline_score-mean)/max(std,1e-6); final_interaction_score = z + 2.0*tanh(raw_cross_attention_residual). The factor 2.0 is fixed and excluded from HPO.
interaction_model.score_outside_shortlist: not evaluated by cross-attention; non-shortlist candidates retain baseline tail order after the shortlist prefix.

internal_confirmation_gate.baseline: identical training-only ESM-C/EnzGFM x DRFP association-transfer shortlist/ranking without cross-attention

external_if_internal_passes.benchmark: CATALYST_TPS_TEMPORAL_R2E_V1 MARTS v2.1 temporal protein-cold (140 queries primary; strict double-cold 8 queries descriptive only)
external_if_internal_passes.model: retrain the exact frozen architecture/HPO configuration on all MARTS v1.5 associations, then evaluate once
external_if_internal_passes.promotion: use the already frozen TPS temporal rule: >=5pp Hit@10 over strongest valid baseline with MRR/MAP non-regression; legacy frozen cells remain descriptive no-regression evidence, not a fresh selector
